signal: Team D3 is now part of Symetri, Autodesk's largest global partner, after merging with Microdesk, expanding planning and process solutions across the combined org.

email.body1:
Joshua, saw Team D3 is now part of Symetri, Autodesk's largest global partner after merging with Microdesk.

A bigger combined footprint usually means more in-market planning and process accounts than your team can personally touch before they go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Symetri off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Joshua, quick follow-up for Symetri.

Post-merger, pipeline targets across the combined book usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Symetri needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Joshua, last bit of proof for Symetri.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Symetri's reply rate likely compares to other Autodesk-ecosystem partners. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Joshua, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while the Symetri integration settles, no problem at all. Timing matters most mid-merger, and I know that stretch keeps a sales team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your planning and process motion? I'll tailor it to Symetri either way.
